record.paper_title: Advances and Open Problems in Federated Learning
record.original_question: How can federated learning jointly address privacy, fairness, and robustness, including adaptive differentially private mechanisms that preserve minority-group performance, evaluation of the fairness impact of differential privacy without sensitive attributes, and integrated models that are simultaneously robust, private, and fair?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a federated learning setting in which K clients, indexed k = 1,...,K, each hold a local data distribution D_k over an input-output space X × Y. A central server coordinates training of a global model h_θ: X → Y by aggregating client updates over rounds, without directly accessing raw client data. Assume the client population partitions into demographic or minority groups {G_j}_{j=1}^J defined by a sensitive attribute s ∈ S (which may or may not be observable to the server or clients).

Three desiderata are required simultaneously:

1. (Privacy) The training protocol satisfies (ε, δ)-differential privacy with respect to either record-level or client-level adjacency, i.e., for any two adjacent datasets D, D′ and any measurable set E of outputs, Pr[M(D) ∈ E] ≤ e^ε · Pr[M(D′) ∈ E] + δ, where M denotes the full training mechanism.

2. (Fairness) For a fairness functional F (for example, demographic parity gap, equalized odds gap, or the maximum per-group excess risk max_j R_{G_j}(h_θ) − min_j R_{G_j}(h_θ), where R_{G_j}(h) = E_{(x,y)∼D | s ∈ G_j}[ℓ(h(x), y)]), one has F(h_θ) ≤ φ for a prescribed tolerance φ > 0.

3. (Robustness) For any adversarial corruption strategy in which up to a fraction α ∈ [0, 1/2) of the clients submit arbitrary (Byzantine) updates, the trained model h_θ satisfies an accuracy guarantee E[ℓ(h_θ(x), y)] ≤ ρ on the honest population distribution, for a prescribed tolerance ρ.

Address the following:

(a) Design an adaptive differentially private federated training mechanism (with per-group or per-client noise calibration and clipping) such that, for fixed overall privacy budget (ε, δ), the maximum degradation in per-group accuracy max_j [R_{G_j}(h_θ^{DP}) − R_{G_j}(h_θ^{non-DP})] is minimized, and prove rigorous utility bounds matching information-theoretic lower bounds up to constants.

(b) Provide a methodology (with provable statistical guarantees) for evaluating the fairness impact F(h_θ^{DP}) − F(h_θ^{non-DP}) of a differentially private federated mechanism when the sensitive attribute s is never observed by the server or by any client, using only privacy-compatible proxy signals.

(c) Construct a single federated training algorithm that simultaneously achieves (1), (2), and (3) above with explicit, jointly tight trade-off curves among (ε, δ, φ, ρ, α) and the achievable utility, and prove an impossibility theorem characterizing the Pareto frontier of attainable tuples (ε, δ, φ, ρ, α, utility).
artifact.status_search_result: This is a broad open research direction. Subsequent literature (post-2021) has produced partial advances on pairs (DP+fairness, DP+robustness, fairness+robustness), but no unified algorithm with tight joint guarantees and a complete Pareto frontier is known. Auditing fairness under DP without sensitive attributes remains an active, unresolved area.

status_evidence.title: Advances and Open Problems in Federated Learning
status_evidence.snippet: Identifies joint privacy, fairness and robustness as an open challenge.
status_evidence.claim: The joint problem is posed as open.

status_evidence.title: On the Compatibility of Privacy and Fairness
status_evidence.snippet: Studies tensions between DP and group fairness, providing partial results and impossibility-style observations.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results exist for DP-fairness compatibility.

status_evidence.title: Differentially Private and Byzantine-Robust Federated Learning
status_evidence.snippet: Combines DP with Byzantine robustness but does not address fairness.
status_evidence.claim: Pairwise progress, but unified privacy-fairness-robustness guarantees remain elusive.
